confirmedGap: CBE task definition is revision/halfLength/halfWidth/speed; interface explicitly advertises dry supported paths. Shared geometry refuses wet unsupported terrain. No fording policy or controller path is implemented.

primaryEvidence.finding: Official published engine change documents negative maxFordingDepth for cars/tanks and car measurement from bounding-box centre; helicopter measurement uses land contacts. This invalidates treating the field as a universal positive ground-depth allowance.
primaryEvidence.limit: Historical primary engine-change statement, not fresh current-engine/type calibration. Tank reference-point semantics and modded vehicle behaviour not established here.

requiredImplementation: Use an explicit per-task crossing policy only when its executor supports it; existing dry/deck policy stays default. Do not add a cosmetic module toggle.

Calculate admissible waterline in the actual vehicle reference frame with a justified safety margin; missing/untrusted configuration is not permission. Resolve present car/tank reference semantics before coding a universal depth rule.
Screen every convoy member, support station, entry/exit grade and hull/body path; lead-vehicle suitability alone cannot admit a mixed column.

Carry policy through labelled Zeus/Eden/script payload, server validation, exact definition/revision, owner execution, active safety checks and original finite return/cleanup. Preserve one movement writer.
No force-float, immunity, teleport, animation/transform correction, unsafe fallback or damage-setting overwrite. Physical crossing/repeat/migration and performance remain separate requirements.
disposition: Research prerequisite clarified; do not implement by deleting WET_SUPPORT or using raw positive maxFordingDepth as ground depth. Requires vehicle-frame policy plus end-to-end task/executor integration.
